recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist 1950s album cover featuring a central gold vinyl record framing a black-and-white halftone portrait, set against a flat cerulean blue background with clean, white serif typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Concentric circles of the gold record framing the central portrait
High-contrast white typography against a medium-value blue field
Symmetrical vertical alignment of text and central graphic
Juxtaposition of metallic gold texture with flat matte background
coreInvariants: Grayscale halftone portrait in the center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The gold record is centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 50% of the canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central black-and-white portrait serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top display text, drop to the central portrait, and finish at the bottom horizontal text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive open blue space on the left and right margins creates a clean, uncluttered feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue background providing a cool, stable base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Metallic gold for the record, providing warmth and a sense of value.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for typography to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Medium saturation blue with high-value white text and high-value yellow-gold.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different sizes and alignments.
graphicDevices: Concentric circular grooves on the gold record
Halftone screen effect on the central photo

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the mid-century editorial feel and serif structure.
Provides the necessary high contrast and elegant sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a flat cerulean blue square background. In the center, place a large gold vinyl record with visible concentric grooves. Inside the center hole of the record, place a circular black-and-white halftone portrait of a man.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using a high-contrast serif font like Century Schoolbook in solid white, place the main title in the top left corner across two lines. Place a secondary title line centered at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the background a flat, solid blue?
Is the gold record perfectly circular and centered?
Is the typography a clean, white serif?
Is the portrait in grayscale halftone?

mustRedesign: Original artist name and album title
Record label logo in the top right corner
Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is overlapping the gold record.
Check that the gold record has a distinct 'grooved' texture.
Verify the blue background is uniform without noise.
Confirm the white text is perfectly legible against the blue.
recipe.reuseFormula: Flat Color Field + Central Circular Metallic Graphic + Halftone Inset + High-Contrast Serif Typography
